title: Forensic Psychology
summary: Forensic psychology: criminal behavior, eyewitness testimony, psychological assessment, rehabilitation, and psychology in legal contexts.
revision: Forensic psychology: criminal behavior, eyewitness testimony, assessment, rehabilitation, legal contexts. Editorial enrichment — limited source coverage.
traps: Forensic psychology = psychology in legal contexts.
Eyewitness testimony affected by memory distortion.

notes.t: The application of psychology to legal and criminal justice contexts, including assessment, testimony, and rehabilitation.

i: Criminal behavior: psychological factors in offending

notes.t: Eyewitness testimony can be unreliable due to memory distortion, suggestibility, and leading questions. Psychological research informs legal procedures.

i: Competency to stand trial: defendant's ability to participate
Criminal responsibility: mental state at offense

notes.t: UGC NET may ask about forensic psychology applications and eyewitness testimony.
